name: q8_w4_quadratic_t3_k16_3000

initialization_bath_reference: unified; common parameters copied by construction, only bath replaced
execution: compiled operators + captured forward/backward + Triton Givens and exact rank-four basis application
state_policy: one persistent field and posterior precision, carried over every chunk and update
comparison_reference: Old W2 K3 champion reference time scale; aborted W4 quadratic T64 run is a numerical failure, not a capability comparison.
primary_outcome: held-out site NLL at matched optimizer update/data budget
mechanistic_outcome: site-averaged total energy decomposed into DC and spatial energy at training snapshots and held-out site terminal states
stopping: 3000 jointly trained optimizer updates, or surfaced numerical failure; record learning curves and convergence evidence before further claims
predictions: Full recurrent gradients should avoid the sustained 1e8..1e10 regime observed at T64; preserve per-group clipping and log raw/actual norms.
Retained spatial structure and held-out language benefit require the full joint training curve.
no_other_architecture_changes: Full write/read/collision networks and differentiable feedback unchanged; physical duration now declared independently of K.
